lines: Sab pech-o-taab-e-shauq ke toofaan tham gaye
couplets.en: All the storms of restless longing fell still.

lines: Woh zulf khul gayi to hawaaon ke kham gaye
couplets.en: When that lock of hair came loose, even the winds lost their curl.

lines: Woh jin ke gham ka tera tabassum hai parda-daar
couplets.en: It is their sorrow your smile keeps hidden.

lines: Aakhir woh kaun the ki ba-mizgaan-e-nam gaye
couplets.en: Who were they, after all, who left with tears on their lashes?

lines: Wahshat si ek laala-e-khoonin kafan se thi
couplets.en: There was a quiet dread in that tulip with its bloodstained shroud.

lines: Wahshat si ek laala-e-khoonin kafan se thi
couplets.en: There was a quiet dread in that tulip with its bloodstained shroud.

lines: Ab ke bahaar aayi to samjho ki hum gaye
couplets.en: If spring comes this time, count me gone.

lines: Aisi koi khabar to nahin saakinaan-e-shahr
couplets.en: Have you heard any such news, you who live in this city?

couplets.en: Have you heard any such news, you who live in this city?

lines: Dariyaa mohabbaton ke jo behte the tham gaye
couplets.en: The rivers that once carried love have fallen still.
